race.description: Be Happy Mach @ Wingate Farm Trotters Mbl
race.comment: CALL ME JACK (2) will enjoy a class drop on what he has faced in his last two outings here. Draws well and has placed in both previous attempts at this shorter distance. Has winning claims. BERTINELLI (1) gave her opponents no chance last start when she cruised to a 12 metre victory at Goulburn. Deserved that following three straight placings. Should enjoy an economical run from this draw so could go on with it. ALPHA STRIDE (10) is worth plenty of thought off after coming from this barrier in a last-start win by 10 metres at this venue. Manners let CHIEF RUNNINGCLOUD (9) down last week but he had recorded a win and second in his previous two outings here so is worth another chance.
